raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Background

Auto Swap Labels uses `secrets.PAT` to evaluate CODEOWNERS team approvals and update review-stage labels. The built-in `github.token` cannot read organization team memberships.

## What changed

- Mint a short-lived installation token for the existing [nemo-automation-bot](https://github.com/apps/nemo-automation-bot), using `vars.COMMUNITY_BOT_ID` and `secrets.COMMUNITY_BOT_KEY`.
- Restrict the token to Megatron-LM with `members: read` and `pull_requests: write`, and pass it to `swap_pr_labels.py` as `GH_TOKEN`.
- Reduce the built-in token to `contents: read` and `actions: read` for checkout and artifact downloads.

## Details

The community App has organization membership access; the release App (`BOT_ID` / `BOT_KEY`) does not. Token creation uses the same pinned `actions/create-github-app-token` revision as the existing Community Bot workflow. It runs only after a valid PR number is available and automatically revokes the token when the job finishes.

## Tested

- `actionlint .github/workflows/auto-swap-labels.yml` — passed with actionlint 1.7.12.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- `BASE_REF=main CHECK_ONLY=true SKIP_DOCS=false bash tools/autoformat.sh` — passed; no Python files changed.
- `gh api apps/nemo-automation-bot`, `gh api apps/nvidia-megatron-lm-release-bot`, `gh api repos/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/variables/COMMUNITY_BOT_ID`, and `gh secret list --repo NVIDIA/Megatron-LM` — verified current App permissions, App ID 1605575, and the existing credential pair.
- Existing [Community Bot run 40895426937](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/runs/40895426937/job/123523096756) successfully created a repository App token requesting `members: read` and `pull_requests: write` with these credentials.
- The modified workflow has not run against a live PR; its event paths execute from the base/default branch after merge.

## Code provenance

No external source code copied or adapted.

detail.title: ci(review): use github app token for label swaps

files.patch:
@@ -11,7 +11,6 @@ on:
     types: [completed]
 
 permissions:
-  pull-requests: write
   contents: read
   actions: read
 
@@ -77,9 +76,22 @@ jobs:
         run: |
           pip install --no-cache-dir codeowners PyGithub slack-sdk
 
+      - name: Create GitHub App token
+        id: app-token
+        if: steps.pr.outputs.number
+        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@fee1f7d63c2ff003460e3d139729b119787bc349 # v2
+        with:
+          # The community App has organization team access; the release App does not.
+          app-id: ${{ vars.COMMUNITY_BOT_ID }}
+          private-key: ${{ secrets.COMMUNITY_BOT_KEY }}
+          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
+          repositories: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
+          permission-members: read
+          permission-pull-requests: write
+
       - name: Run Auto Swap Labels
         if: steps.pr.outputs.number
         env:
-          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT }}
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
           PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}
         run: python tests/test_utils/python_scripts/swap_pr_labels.py
